HNO3 is limiting in the neutralisation, leaving 14.0 - 7.50 = 6.50 mmol OH- in a total volume of 15.0 + 35.0 = 50.0 mL, so [OH-] = 6.50 mmol / 50.0 mL = 0.130 M.
